pr_title: Add global configuration option for zero metrics
pr_body:
##### Summary
If all metrics are zero in a chart, it is not displayed by default. A global configuration option will be added to allow users to see charts with all zero metrics if desired. 

Closes #6315

##### Component Name
proc plugin
diskspace plugin
cgroups plugin
freebsd plugin
macos plugin
tc plugin
pr_comments: ok, i tested the PR installing it from source. Works as expected.

issue_context.title: Global option for enabling charts with zero metrics
issue_context.body:
##### Feature idea summary
By default, Netdata will enable monitoring metrics for disks, memory, and network only when they are not zero. These charts can be enabled permanently using the corresponding configuration options but we already have over 200 such options. It is desirable to have the possibility to change the default behaviour globally.

Preliminary discussion on the matter: #5845

##### Expected behavior
It is possible to enable all charts with zero values using a global configuration option.
